subject: Short pilot pricing — modular discount & engineering slab
messages:
From: Jamie Li <jamie.li@nexlayer.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Short pilot pricing — modular discount & engineering slab

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at NexLayer is keen to run a short 3‑week pilot focused on summarization and search over our support knowledge base. Two things we need to clarify on your side before we can start:

1) Pricing: because this is a short, timeboxed evaluation (3 weeks) we want to understand whether Redwood can do a modular discount (milestone or outcome‑tied credits) rather than a straight % off the rate card.

2) Engineering support: we will likely need ~8–12 hours of Redwoods’ engineering time for integration and a small prompt‑engineering pass. Can that be bundled as an "engineering slab" in the pilot price?

If you can share a SOW or quick pricing options today/tomorrow that would help procurement.

Best,
Jamie
Jamie's signature
Head of AI Platforms, NexLayer
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@nexlayer.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short pilot pricing — modular discount & engineering slab

Hi Jamie — great to hear. Looping in Karthik from Solutions for pricing details. Quick answer up front and attaching a draft SOW: NexLayer_POC_SOW_v2.pdf (attached).

Options (high level):

A) Timebox + modular credits (recommended)
  - 3‑week pilot, pay standard time‑boxed rate for capacity + receive milestone credits: 15% of committed tokens credited back if evaluation reaches integration milestone (define in SOW).
  - Engineering slab: optional 8 hours included at a flat $1,200 (one‑time add) so you have guaranteed SE time for integration and prompt tuning.

B) Discounted prepay
  - Prepay the estimated token spend for 3 weeks at a 20% discount, no engineering included (can add at $200/hr).

C) Pay-as-you-go + capped ops credit
  - Pay standard rates, Redwood provides up to 6 hours of engineering as an ops credit; additional hours billed.

Quick asks from our side to make this actionable:
 - Which option do you prefer?
 - Who in Procurement should I send the SOW to? (cc works)
 - Any invoice terms preference (Net30/Net45)?

Attaching: NexLayer_POC_SOW_v2.pdf — has milestone language and acceptance criteria.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20‑minute call if you'd like to run the options.

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jamie Li <jamie.li@nexlayer.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short pilot pricing — modular discount & engineering slab

Hi all — quick pricing table (see attached pricing_matrix.xlsx) to make comparisons easier. Key details:

- Engineering slab: we can do an 8‑hour slab bundled at $1,200 (covers SE time for integration + 1 prompt tuning session). If you need 12 hours, it's $1,700.
- Modular credit option (A): credit is applied as a % of committed spend and is visible on first invoice as a credit line. Credit triggers: code push + successful example queries passing QA (we list 4 acceptance tests in the SOW).
- Prepay (B): 20% off only if prepaid in full for the pilot.
- Invoice terms: standard for pilots is Net30; Finance prefers Net30 for short pilots but will consider Net45 for larger enterprise deals with a purchase order.

I've attached pricing_matrix.xlsx with the line items.

Attachments: pricing_matrix.xlsx

Happy to review the SOW and sharpen the milestone language if you want me to add phrasing for the QA pass.

-Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procurement@nexlayer.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short pilot pricing — modular discount & engineering slab

Thanks for the options. Procurement priorities:

- We prefer a single bundled price for the 3‑week evaluation (simpler for our tracking team).
- Net45 is our standard for POs; Net30 is a hard ask for us only for very small vendors.
- Regarding discounts: 20% prepay is attractive but we cannot prepay for pilots. Would Redwood consider a 10% discount on the standard rate + include 8 hours engineering slab at the $1,200 flat fee?

If you can provide a bundled SOW + a PO‑ready invoice for Net45, we can route it through procurement.

—Procurement, NexLayer
From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short pilot pricing — modular discount & engineering slab

Olga / Karthik — finance perspective:

- Net45 is acceptable for NexLayer provided the deal is committed (deal_id NX-2026-114) and procurement provides a PO. We'll run Net45 for this one‑off pilot but need a signed SOW and the pricing locked.
- Discount flexibility: we can accept 10% off for pilots under $20k. If the pilot total spend (after credits) will exceed $20k, we need a stronger commercial justification (exec approval).
- Engineering slab can be included as a line item; please ensure the SOW includes clear deliverables for the 8 hours.

I'll approve Net45 and 10% discount if you want me to — confirm and I'll mark finance approval in the HubSpot deal.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@nexlayer.com>, Procurement <procurement@nexlayer.com>

Subject: Re: Short pilot pricing — modular discount & engineering slab

Thanks everyone — glad we have a path. Summary / ask:

- Offer accepted: Bundled pilot (3 weeks) using Option A structure but simplified into a single line item on the invoice.
  - Pilot bundled price = estimated capacity + 10% discount (as approved by Grace).
  - Engineering slab: 8 hours included at $1,200 (line item).
  - Modular credit: 10% of committed spend will be issued as an invoice credit if acceptance criteria in the SOW are met.
- Invoice terms: Net45 per Procurement request (Grace confirmed).

Next steps:
 1) I will update the SOW to a PO‑ready version and attach it + a PO‑ready invoice PDF via DocuSign. Link will be sent this afternoon: https://docusign.com/ABC123-NEXLAYER-POC
 2) Jamie / Procurement — please confirm the billing contact and PO number when you have it.

If that all looks good, we'll queue SE time and target a pilot start the week of 6/29.
